card.name: Just before the word sides
card.fires_on: Words right before an expected 'side' or 'sides', mostly the verb in 'take sides' or similar wording about picking or switching a party, camp or faction in a conflict.

modes.label: Take sides
modes.description: The verb 'take' or the word 'to' just before 'sides' in the phrase about choosing a camp.
modes.example: Entering the conflict is to<< take>> sides.

modes.label: Switching allegiance
modes.description: Verbs or words about choosing, switching or joining a party or camp in political or war settings.
modes.example: Both of those poor showings occurred following an FDP decision to<< switch>> coalition partners.

modes.label: On our side
modes.description: A possessive or other word that leads into 'side' meaning a camp.
modes.example: Wisdom, experience, and the Constitution are on<< our>> side

card.writes: It pushes the model to write 'side' or 'sides' next, as in taking sides.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before 'sides' when text is about picking a camp in a conflict.
